requiredJourney: Article → Relevant Service → Relevant Practitioner → Book Appointment
articleRules: Every article links to at least one relevant service
Every article links to verified practitioner profiles with relevant publicly stated interests
Every article has an in-site HotDoc lightbox booking CTA
Every article links to related Knowledge Centre guides
Every article includes trusted external Australian information where relevant

authorityClusterRule.bidirectionalClusterLinks: Each article must link to every other guide in its topical cluster and to its existing category hub.
authorityClusterRule.serviceReturnPath: Each service page must offer relevant links back into the Knowledge Centre.
authorityClusterRule.practitionerReturnPath: Each practitioner page must offer verified, scope-relevant patient guide links.
authorityClusterRule.longFormContent: Preserve clinical detail; use existing On This Page navigation, clear headings, FAQ sections and section anchors.
authorityClusterRule.approvalGate: Show reviewedBy, lastReviewed and contentOwner only after actual owner submission, signed review and practice approval recorded outside the public website.
